# GraphRD

> An RDF database in one binary: SPARQL 1.1 and 1.2, rule-based inference,
> full-text, vector and geospatial search, SHACL, GraphQL, SQL — with a web UI inside.

Docs:

- [Getting started](https://graphrd.org/getting-started.md): GraphRD is a single binary: the server, the web UI and the offline tools. This page takes you from
- [Command line](https://graphrd.org/cli.md)
- [HTTP API](https://graphrd.org/http-api.md): GraphRD answers four families of requests on one port (default 7200):
- [SPARQL](https://graphrd.org/sparql.md): GraphRD implements SPARQL 1.1 Query and Update completely, SPARQL 1.2 (the W3C draft), and a few
- [GraphQL](https://graphrd.org/graphql.md): Every repository answers GraphQL queries with a schema derived from its data: no schema to write
- [SQL over the PostgreSQL protocol](https://graphrd.org/sql.md): With --pg-port, GraphRD also speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol (version 3), so psql, psycopg,
- [Questions in plain language](https://graphrd.org/nl-query.md): GraphRD can answer a question written in plain language ("Which people over 30 work for ACME?")
- [Formats](https://graphrd.org/formats.md)
- [Examples](https://graphrd.org/examples.md): Runnable programs that talk to a running GraphRD server — in the repository's
- [Inference](https://graphrd.org/inference.md): Each repository has a ruleset. When statements are added, GraphRD derives what follows from them
- [Full-text search](https://graphrd.org/fts.md): GraphRD can index the words of every literal and find literals by a text query, inside SPARQL.
- [Search connectors](https://graphrd.org/connectors.md): A connector keeps a repository's entities of chosen classes in an OpenSearch (or Elasticsearch)
- [Vector search](https://graphrd.org/vectors.md): GraphRD indexes embedding vectors stored as literals and finds the nearest ones from SPARQL, so
- [GeoSPARQL](https://graphrd.org/geosparql.md): GraphRD implements the GeoSPARQL 1.1 functions over geometry literals with a geometry engine of
- [SHACL validation](https://graphrd.org/shacl.md): A repository with isShacl on validates every write against SHACL shapes and refuses writes that
- [Administration](https://graphrd.org/admin.md)
- [Cluster](https://graphrd.org/cluster.md): Several GraphRD servers form a cluster with the Raft consensus protocol. Every node holds all the
- [Storage](https://graphrd.org/storage.md): This page describes how a repository keeps its data: the files, the indexes, the dictionary,
- [Performance](https://graphrd.org/performance.md)
- [Security](https://graphrd.org/security.md)

- [Full documentation](https://graphrd.org/llms-full.txt): every page in one file
